prompt:
Create ONE clean transparent PNG horizontal action animation spritesheet for Lumina Nang Am Sprout Form.
Use the attached MASTER render as the strict identity source.

Character identity to preserve exactly:
tiny round baby sprout spirit pet, fluffy cream body, warm amber-brown eyes, tiny orange nose, peach blush cheeks, tiny paws, small fluffy side arms, glowing heart mark on chest, exactly two fresh green sprout leaves on head. Do not add antlers, big leaf tail, accessories, or evolve it.

ACTION GOAL:
A tiny cute side-view run / soft rolling trot to the right. Baby sprout body bounces gently, tiny paws move quickly, sprout leaves bob with follow-through. Keep it adorable, low to the ground, not too fast or wild.

CRITICAL OUTPUT FORMAT:
- One single transparent PNG spritesheet.
- Layout exactly 8 columns x 6 rows, total exactly 48 sequential animation frames.
- The animation order is left to right, top to bottom, like a long game battle movement/action cycle.
- Every cell is the same size and contains exactly one full character pose.
- Character should face and move toward the right side of the screen.
- Keep the character fully inside every cell with safe padding.
- Keep scale, ground/air registration, and silhouette consistent.
- No background, no checkerboard baked in, real alpha transparency only.
- No text, labels, frame numbers, UI, props, extra characters, weapons, particles, or effects.
- Do not crop head, ears, wings, leaves, antlers, tail, feet, or body.

MOTION PLAN:
Frames 01-08: start moving horizontally to the right, gentle anticipation and first steps/flaps.
Frames 09-16: speed builds, readable side-facing movement, body bob/flap rhythm.
Frames 17-24: full smooth movement cycle, lively but cute.
Frames 25-32: continued movement, small variation in pose and expression.
Frames 33-40: second movement cycle, consistent identity and scale.
Frames 41-48: loop-compatible finish that can connect back to frame 01.

Style: cozy Walkamon mobile game battle asset, cute chibi fantasy, soft hand-painted look, warm friendly expression, readable at 128px, no realism, no horror, no harsh neon, no heavy black outlines.
